# RBAC and PBAC matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-rbac-matrix.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Source of truth: `platform/backend/app/security/permissions.yaml`.
The Security Center renders the same matrix from the live RBAC tables, so an
administrator's reviewed grant edits appear there immediately. This file is the
reviewable snapshot for pull requests and auditors.

## How to read it

- **RBAC** answers *what kind of work may this role do?* The table shows the
  reviewed baseline grants. A stored administrator edit can change them.
- **PBAC** answers *may this actor do it to this record, in this tenant, with
  this learner's consent?* A role grant is necessary but not sufficient.
- `✓` means the role has the permission in the reviewed baseline. A blank cell
  means the role must obtain the permission another way: owner scope, a verified
  share, a course assignment, or a break-glass grant.
- A permission marked `restricted` is never granted to a role. It requires the
  record owner, a live share, or a time-bound break-glass grant.

## PBAC policy rules

| Rule | What it decides | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|
| **Default deny** | An unknown permission, unknown role, or missing dependency is denied. | `app.services.authorization.AuthorizationService` |
| **Server-resolved roles** | Roles come from the RBAC tables, never from a JWT claim or request body. | `app.services.rbac.effective_roles` |
| **Tenant boundary** | Every role is confined to its reviewed tenant scope; only admin is cross-tenant. | `app.security.tenant + PostgreSQL RLS` |
| **Self scope** | A self-scoped permission is allowed only when the target is the caller. | `authorize(resource_user_id=...)` |
| **Explicit share** | A shared permission requires shared=True from a verified, live share token. | `portfolio/certificate share verification` |
| **Course scope** | A course-scoped permission requires an owned or assigned course in the actor's tenant. | `authorize(course_id=...)` |
| **Private derived data** | Private DNA, GPS, transcript, and AI data require owner, share, or break-glass; never a role grant. | `SENSITIVE_PRIVATE_PERMISSIONS` |
| **Consent gate** | Revoked learner consent blocks derived-data processing, including break-glass access. | `consent middleware + AuthorizationService` |
| **Auditor read-only** | The auditor role may use read-only permissions only. | `READ_ONLY_PERMISSIONS` |
| **Break-glass controls** | Emergency access is time-bound, MFA-gated, reasoned, optionally approved, reviewed, and never changes the role. | `app.services.authorization + break-glass service` |
| **Export ceiling** | Export requires export.data plus the rank permission and the actor's institution role/region ceiling; Restricted is blocked by default. | `export authorization + data labels` |
| **Service identity** | A non-human identity has no password login and only its explicit, expiring scopes. | `app.services.service_identities` |

## Review checklist

- [ ] Every new permission has a description, category, sensitivity, scope,
      read-only flag, and break-glass flag.
- [ ] Every permission is granted to at least one role, unless it is deliberately
      private and requires owner, share, or break-glass access.
- [ ] `admin` has no restricted permission.
- [ ] `auditor` receives read-only permissions only.
- [ ] Tenant scope is `global` only for `admin`, `explicit` only for
      `service_account`, and `shared` only for external share roles.
- [ ] The generated matrix is current (`python scripts/generate-rbac-matrix.py --check`).
